meta.title: SAR Refusal — 'Ongoing Investigation' & Misstated Crime Ref (Right of Access Request 1567/25)

content.subject: RE: Article 12 – UK-GDPR – Right of Access Request 1567/25
content.body: SAR refusal citing 'ongoing investigation' and stating the 2024 case 47240141246 was 'overtaken by 47230214305' (a 2023-formatted reference). Indicates material cannot be disclosed until conclusion.
